pricingPage.freeTitle: It's free. The only catch is a daily limit.
pricingPage.freeLead: The analysis, the Negotiation Playbook, the emails, every round: free for everyone. We cap usage so the AI bill stays sane, that's all. The one thing we charge for is doing the negotiation for you.
pricingPage.freeIncludedUnit: no card, no trial clock, no upsell
pricingPage.freeF2: Every red flag, what to ask for, and the fallback
pricingPage.freeF3: The Negotiation Playbook on every deal: ordered asks with amounts, your leverage, what you can offer
pricingPage.freeF4: Ready-to-send email in the right tone
pricingPage.freeF5: Vendor replies analysed round by round, {regen} email rewrites per round
pricingPage.freeF6: Saved deals, vendors, insights, in English or French
pricingPage.freeLimitsBody: {day} new analyses a day and {month} a month per account, one try a day without an account. If the free capacity for the day is used up across everyone, you'll see a message and it resets at midnight UTC. Your deals are never affected.
pricingPage.negEyebrow: The one thing we charge for
pricingPage.negMin: {min} minimum. Invoiced after the signed deal, never before.
pricingPage.whyTitle: We'd rather have you using it than paying for it. For now.
pricingPage.whyBody: TermLift is early. A few people negotiating real quotes and telling us what's wrong is worth more than a paywall nobody has crossed. If that changes we'll say so a month ahead, and everything you built stays yours.
pricingPage.faq1a: Yes. The analysis, the Negotiation Playbook, the emails and every follow-up round cost nothing, for everyone. No card, no trial clock, no feature behind a button that asks for money.
pricingPage.faq2q: What happens when I hit the limit?
pricingPage.faq2a: You get a plain message. The per-account limit is {day} new analyses a day and {month} a month; it resets at midnight UTC and on the 1st. Playbooks, emails and rounds on your existing deals keep working. Very rarely the free capacity for the whole day is used up; that also resets at midnight.
pricingPage.faq3q: How is the negotiation service priced?
pricingPage.faq3a: Success-based: {pct}% of the savings TermLift verifies against your original quote, with a {min} minimum. No savings, no fee. Nothing is agreed with the vendor without your approval, and you sign the contract yourself.
pricingPage.faq4a: For as long as we can keep the cost sane with the limits above. If that ever changes we'll announce it a month ahead, and every analysis, Playbook and email you built stays yours.
pricingPage.faq5q: Can I stop at any step?
pricingPage.faq5a: Yes. Read the analysis and leave. Build the Playbook and negotiate yourself. Or hand one deal to TermLift. You can also delete any deal, or your whole account, at any time.

settingsPage.usageNote: Playbooks, emails and rounds are included. Want a deal negotiated for you? TermLift Negotiate is {pct}% of verified savings.

billing.a1: Yes. The analysis, the Negotiation Playbook, the emails and every round are free for everyone. No card, no trial clock. Try one quote without signing up, then create a free account to keep your deals.
billing.a2: {day} new analyses a day and {month} a month per account, plus one try a day without an account. Playbooks, emails and rounds on your existing deals never count against that number. The limits exist so the AI bill stays sane, nothing else.
billing.q3: What does the Negotiation Playbook cost?
billing.a3: Nothing. It is built on every deal, for free: the asks, fallbacks, leverage, the email and every follow-up round.
billing.a4: For as long as the limits keep the cost sane. If that ever changes we will say so a month ahead, and everything you built stays yours.

termsPage.s5Intro: There is no subscription and nothing to pay for the analysis. The one paid service is the negotiation, below.
termsPage.s5QuickTitle: Analysis, Negotiation Playbook, emails and rounds — free
termsPage.s5QuickDesc: Free for every account, within technical limits of {day} new analyses a day and {month} a month, plus one analysis a day without an account. No card required. We may change these limits to keep the service sustainable.
termsPage.s5DeepDesc: No feature of the analysis is sold separately. If we ever introduce a paid plan we will announce it at least one month ahead, and anything you built before that stays available to you.
termsPage.s5Item3: We provide the analysis and the Negotiation Playbook free of charge. That does not oblige us to keep doing so indefinitely; see section 5.
